Pipe size
Left-drag to orbit · right-drag or Shift+drag to pan · scroll to zoom · click a pipe to open its drawings

Progress

Weighted by diameter-inches, so a 48" weld counts 96 times a 1/2" weld. Weld counts are shown alongside.

Pipe tracker

Every pipe piece from every iso BOM, measured in feet. Open a line and use "Pipe to install" under its drawing to mark pieces Not installed, In progress or Installed.

Lines, all sheets combined

Bill of materials by line

Read from the BOM table on every iso sheet of the line. The same BOM # and description are combined: pipe lengths are added up, other items are counted. A quantity written in any other form is listed exactly as written, left out of the totals and listed as an RFI in the Excel download. Clicking a line anywhere on the page opens its BOM here too.
